title: 5/09-5/26 live-forward (#16) stream integrity defects: void/no-PA rows stuck pending, stale-snapshot drift checks, resolver unit failed on archives, false CRITICAL on null provenance
tier_reason: research-stream integrity and alert-noise issues without data loss: canonical artifacts kept resolving (5/23 check) and the 9/22 inventory found every pre-outcome slate resolved and verified; one false CRITICAL

contract.text: Each live-forward slate is captured pre-outcome with a production-pick snapshot that matches the locked decision, resolves to a terminal status per row (resolved or a void class) without failing on archives, and the capture/resolution health surfaces alert only on real gaps.

mechanism.text: the resolver treated a postponed/cancelled source-date game's missing PA rows as pending with no terminal void status, so the 2026-05-09 postponed slate could not leave pending_outcomes
the capture did not check that an existing artifact's production-pick snapshot still matched the current production pick, so a stale snapshot could stand in the official root
the drift check compared whole-file hashes, so post-game result/slot_results writes made a valid at-lock snapshot look stale; capture was also not triggered at pick lock

the resolver's default discovery also scanned *.stale_pick_snapshot.* archive directories; archives with failed_verify_existing left the one-shot bts-live-forward-resolve.service failed although canonical dates resolved
rows for a final game with loaded PA data but no PA for the player had no terminal status (no void_no_pa) and stayed pending
verification of outcome_status_counts failed on older manifests lacking the newly added zero-count statuses

after result reconciliation the pick file gained nullable feature_env* fields; the snapshot comparison treated absent vs null as drift, marked the valid canonical artifact failed_recapture_post_resolution and the end-of-day analytics_artifacts_missing check raised CRITICAL

verified_recovered.how: manual check after the deploy: Result=success, ExecMainStatus=0, is-failed=inactive

watchdog.trigger: a canonical live-forward slate remains pending/failed past its grace window, or a resolver/capture unit is left failed, or a capture status reports drift/recapture failure for a date whose decision fields match the locked pick
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every canonical slate reaches a terminal verified status and the resolver/capture units end inactive/success

evidence.what: the 2026-05-25 end-of-day health run emitted a CRITICAL analytics_artifacts_missing for capture status failed_recapture_post_resolution; production evidence showed no capture outage - absent-vs-null feature_env* fields added after reconciliation made the valid artifact look stale

evidence.locator: docs/superpowers/runbooks/2026-05-23-alert-disposition.md at 3b3e810 ('Current live evidence' + first table row)
evidence.what: bts-live-forward-resolve.service had been left failed because default discovery scanned *.stale_pick_snapshot.* archives (some failed_verify_existing) while canonical dates resolved; cleared by PR #112 and verified Result=success after deploy
the resolver stays strict by default; the known 2026-05-09 postponed slate had to be converted from pending_outcomes to resolved_with_voids with the new opt-in
first successful deploys containing 09ee616, 429a998, 9340218, 2efd40a, c511a03, 3710227 and f03a98b respectively; all logs unavailable_expired
9/22 inventory: 114 pre-outcome directories 5/09-9/18, all resolved complete with verification ok; 255 stale_pick_snapshot.* recapture side-directories exist

notes: split? seven distinct defects; observed: link 7 (5/25 false CRITICAL, ev1) and link 4 (resolver unit failed, ev2); link 1 is a capability gap in a strict-by-design resolver (the 5/09 slate stayed pending, ev3); links 2, 3, 5, 6 have empty or one-line bodies and no located observation (deployed_latent)
